title: ITR-4 Deductions: Documents for Tax Benefits (TY 2026-27)
description: ITR-4 is for individuals, HUFs, and partnership firms opting for presumptive taxation under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, or 44AE. This form simplifies tax filing by .

faq.q: Who is eligible to file ITR-4?
faq.a: ITR-4 can be filed by resident individuals, Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), and partnership firms (excluding LLPs) with a total income up to ₹50 lakhs, who have opted for presumptive taxation under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, or 44AE.

faq.q: Can I claim HRA with ITR-4?
faq.a: Yes, if you have salary income and are opting for the Old Tax Regime, you can claim HRA exemption. However, if you choose the new tax regime, HRA exemption is generally not available.

faq.q: Do I need to maintain books of accounts if I file ITR-4?
faq.a: No, if you declare your income at or above the prescribed presumptive rates under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, or 44AE, you are not required to maintain detailed books of accounts.

faq.q: What happens if my actual profit is lower than the presumptive income?
faq.a: If your actual profit is lower than the presumptive income, and you wish to declare this lower profit, you cannot opt for the presumptive taxation scheme. In such a case, you would need to maintain proper books of accounts and get them audited, then file ITR-3.

faq.q: Can I switch between presumptive taxation and regular taxation?
faq.a: Yes, you can opt in or out of the presumptive taxation scheme. However, if you opt out of Section 44AD in any year, you are barred from opting into it for the next five assessment years.

faq.q: Are capital gains reported in ITR-4?
faq.a: No, if you have any income from capital gains (e.g., from selling shares, mutual funds, or property), you are not eligible to file ITR-4 and must choose another applicable ITR form, usually ITR-2 or ITR-3.

faq.q: What is the deadline for filing ITR-4 for TY 2026-27?
faq.a: For individuals, HUFs, and firms not requiring an audit, the general deadline for filing ITR-4 for Tax Year 2026-27 (Financial Year 2026-27) is typically 31st July 2027.
